newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Taiwan to buy 7,000/T Dec MTBE at $275-$277/T.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan to buy 7,000/T Dec MTBE at $275-$277/T.

text.p: Taiwan's state-owned Chinese Petroleum Corp (CPC) plans to award its buy tender for 7,000 tonnes of methyl tertiary butyl ether (MTBE) at $275-$278 per tonne, an official said on Tuesday.
The tender closed November 4 and offers are valid until November 6.
CPC tendered for either 3,500 tonnes or 7,000 tonnes for delivery December 1-15 on a cost-and-freight basis to Kaohsiung or Taichung December 1-15.
CPC bought its last requirement, a 7,000-tonne cargo for November 1-15 delivery at around the same price.
